title: Welcome to Docker
blurb: A cheerful Vite + React landing page — the perfect first deploy to prove your pipeline works.

title: podinfo
blurb: The go-to Kubernetes demo microservice — tiny Go app with pretty UI, health endpoints, and tracing.

title: KUARD
blurb: Kubernetes Up And Running Demo. Interactive UI showing pods, env, probes, liveness — a legend.

title: whoami
blurb: A tiny Go server that prints OS + request info. The easiest way to prove ingress is wired up.

title: fake-service
blurb: Configurable mock microservice for testing service meshes, timeouts, and chaos scenarios.

title: HashiCorp http-echo
blurb: Respond to any HTTP request with a fixed message. Single binary, 3 MB image. Perfect smoke test.

title: mendhak/http-https-echo
blurb: Receives a request, echoes it back with headers, cookies, body — great for debugging proxies.

title: HTTPBin
blurb: An HTTP request and response service — the Swagger of debugging network behaviour.

title: Kelsey's Hello World
blurb: Kelsey Hightower's minimal Go hello-world. The image is smaller than this blurb.

title: inanimate echo-server
blurb: A small Go HTTP echo server — handy for verifying TLS termination and headers.

title: MailCatcher
blurb: Catches SMTP on one side, serves them to a browser on the other. Your dev inbox.

title: Dozzle
blurb: Realtime log viewer for Docker containers. No database, no config, just logs.

title: File Browser
blurb: A web file manager with a clean UI — share, upload, and manage files via a browser.

title: IT-Tools
blurb: A collection of handy online tools for developers — all offline-capable and self-hosted.

title: Excalidraw
blurb: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams. Beloved by engineers everywhere.

title: Homepage
blurb: A modern, fast, secure, highly customizable dashboard for your self-hosted stack.

title: Vaultwarden
blurb: Unofficial Bitwarden-compatible server written in Rust — feather-light password manager.

title: code-server (LinuxServer)
blurb: Run VS Code on any machine, access from a browser. LinuxServer's production-hardened build.

title: Remix Indie Stack
blurb: A production-ready Remix starter with auth, DB, and deployment config out of the box.

title: Grafana
blurb: The open observability platform. Dashboards for metrics, logs, and traces.

title: Directus
blurb: Instant REST and GraphQL API + admin app for any SQL database. Needs Postgres.

title: Metabase
blurb: The easy, open-source BI tool — ask questions of your data. Needs a DB to point at.

title: Gitea
blurb: Git with a cup of tea. Painless self-hosted Git service. Needs a DB for real usage.

title: Umami Analytics
blurb: A simple, fast, privacy-focused Google Analytics alternative. Requires Postgres.

title: Plausible Analytics
blurb: Privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative. Production deploy needs Postgres + Clickhouse.
